```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| include: false
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "GMM spectrum caption"
)
Scenarios <- ScenarioTable[siteID %in% SiteID.caption, ID]
if (!length(Scenarios)) stop("GMPE.PSA: no scenarios for the selected site.", call. = FALSE)
p.target <- c("0.10", "0.16", "0.50", "0.84", "0.90")
Vs30.target <- 760
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.GMPE.PSA")
```

:::{.panel-tabset .full-width}

```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (Scenario in Scenarios) {
  cat("\n#### ", Scenario, "\n\n", sep = "")
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_fig/GMPE.PSA.one.qmd",
    stem = .composeTargetStem(paste("gmm", tolower(Scenario), "psa", sep = "-")),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(ID.target = Scenario),
    root = root
  )
}
rm(Scenario)
```
